svg.title: A pit stop in the middle of the race. 1. On track: mid-session 2. The car feels wrong: the same failed call, for the third time 3. Into the box: a new part: the model writes harness code 4. Five lights: five checks, all must pass 5. Back out. Same race.: fitted before the task is over 6. The next laps tell: the same 22 sessions: 7 without it, 1 with it 7. The next race starts with this car: and the improved car improves again
svg.text: A pit stop in the middle of the race
A driver who feels the car is wrong does not wait for the next race. Neither does the harness.

g.text: the same failed call, for the third time
fitted before the task is over
Into the box: a new part
The next race starts with this car
and the improved car improves again
the same 22 sessions: 7 without it, 1 with it
